title: Preserve indexed catalog cursor paging independently of exact counts
outcome: The continuation predicate moved outside the filtered CTE. Confirm the query plan and keep the page cursor index-seekable without relying on flattening; the count must exclude the cursor. This is a query-plan risk, not a measured slowdown.
acceptance: An EXPLAIN or fullscan regression proves later catalog pages retain indexed continuation with availability filters while the exact total remains cursor-independent.

completion.summary: Page continuation is inside the candidate CTE; the count deliberately excludes it. The test-only EXPLAIN regression asserts work_items_catalog_after seeks project_id plus work_id range with availability filters and no temporary B-tree. No runtime plan machinery was added.
